findings.ac: 3d and 3z refuse to run a Spike
findings.text: The slice adds no tests. The 3d Phase 0 step 0 halt literal '[SPIKE] BT-<n> is not buildable...' and the 3z preflight 'status:needs_spec (Spike), any mode' skip/HALT exist only as workflow prose. MockOrchestrator.step_1b_preflight in tests/workflows/test_3z_orchestrator_simulation.py has no needs_spec branch. tests/workflows/test_3d_plan_phase.py has no assertion on the Spike guard, so removing either guard would fail nothing.

findings.ac: 3c never proposes status:planned for a Spike
findings.text: 3c Phase 5 step 2 ('Set status to status:planned for Build slices only; Spikes keep status:needs_spec') and Phase 2 sorting exist as prose only. No test in tests/ references 3c-sprint-planning. A regression to promoting Spikes would not fail any assertion. The 'pytest tests/workflows tests/lifecycle passes' AC proves nothing about this.

The only text is 3b Phase 3 step 5 ('default v1.0.0; Spikes too'), which sets the BACKLOG_MAP milestone column. The GitHub milestone for a Spike at mint time (step 4) is not stated: the only 'gh issue create --milestone' is in the audit-epic example. No test covers it.

findings.ac: Change section: Spikes sized size:medium (3h) sharing the 80h budget
findings.text: The issue body says Spikes are sized size:medium (3h) and that unlabelled priority sorts last. The diff instead makes Spikes a flat 5h with no size: label (issue-templates.md, 3c Phase 3), and sorts unlabelled scope last. 3b Phase 3 step 4 still lists 'Size (size:small/medium/large)' in the canonical labels for all issues with no Spike exception, which contradicts the Spike template's 'no size:'. The issue text and shipped behavior disagree.

src/experimental/jules-dispatch/dispatch.py select_eligible now drops 'status:needs_spec', but test_select_eligible_dep_exclusion in tests/jules/test_jules_dispatch.py has no needs_spec case. The exclusion is unasserted.

3d Phase 0 step 2 no longer removes status:needs_spec, but test_3z_orchestrator_simulation.py (lines ~69 and ~194) still asserts the old command with '--remove-label status:needs_spec'. The mock encodes the pre-change command, so the test does not reflect the shipped workflow text.
